newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BARESI RETIRES AFTER 20 YEARS WITH MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARESI RETIRES AFTER 20 YEARS WITH MILAN.

text.p: Veteran Italy defender Franco Baresi announced his retirement from professional soccer on Monday after 20 consecutive seasons with AC Milan.
Baresi, 37, said he would stay at the club as a vice-president and would also work with the youth team.
"I'm here to confirm that I'm leaving competitive football," he told a packed news conference in Milan. "I've thought about it a lot but I think now's the right moment."
Baresi made his serie A debut with Milan on April 23, 1978, and played his last match for the five-times European champions at the end of the 1996-97 season.
He played 716 official games at the heart of the club's defence, winning six Italian league titles and three European Cups. He also played 81 times for his country.
